review_method: Complete source text read for exactly the three files below; line evidence is tied to the current bytes and hash. No imports, COMSOL startup or test execution.

runtime.claim_limit: Findings are static semantic observations and required follow-up points, never runtime PASS evidence.

automated_inventory_pointer.required_interpretation: AUTOMATED_INVENTORY_ONLY; semantic_reviewed=false; do not treat its per-file inventory as a semantic PASS.

files.responsibility: Public MCP numerical cases C04-C10 and Chain-B multidimensional axis checks.
oracle_sources: ORACLES constants fixed in source before run (lines 8-15).
Analytic comments for polynomial, weighted, centered-variance, axisymmetric and parameter-time fixtures (lines 99-109, 136-142, 190-240).
Engine-reported dataset solution_indices and parameter metadata are used for Chain-B axis binding (lines 216-240); this is an engine metadata oracle, not an independent physical oracle.

cases.meaning: Builds a fresh constant-field fixture and checks integral, average, std and RMS against [6,9], [2,3], [0,0] and [2,3].
Checks 2-D all/subset, 3-D volume, 1-D endpoint/line dimensions and non-default component/geometry; scalar values are flattened.
Checks x+2y integral/average/std/RMS, a positive nonconstant weight and a large-offset centered standard deviation.
Checks real/imag/abs/phase and preserve modes for constant and varying complex expressions, including transform-before-statistics.
Checks m versus mm point reads, coordinate readback and unsupported frame/dimension refusals; records PARTIAL because two controls remain.
Checks axisymmetric volume, mean radius and outer side integral against the cylinder oracle.
Runs a real parametric/time study, checks engine axes and parameter pairs, FieldArray shape [2,4,5,3], aggregates, selection, slices and invalid bindings.

line_evidence.observation: close() recursively flattens lists and compares only count, scalar type, finiteness and value tolerance.
line_evidence.conclusion: A wrong axis order or nesting can pass if the flattened sequence happens to match; this helper is not a shape/order oracle.

line_evidence.observation: action() dispatches with reconcile=False and handles only error.code EXECUTION_STATE_UNKNOWN; it returns data after checking success boolean.
line_evidence.conclusion: A success envelope carrying data.status RUNNING/QUEUED or rpc_wait_expired can be treated as completed, allowing a later mutation before quiescence is proven.

line_evidence.observation: UNKNOWN reconciliation checks three observations and model_inspect, then adopts the readback.
line_evidence.conclusion: This is useful evidence for an actual UNKNOWN error, but it does not cover non-error running envelopes and terminal status handling is narrower than the C15 helper.

line_evidence.observation: C10 is explicitly recorded as status PARTIAL after m/mm and geometry checks.
line_evidence.conclusion: A caller that only asserts no exception can report a suite PASS while this case is incomplete; PARTIAL must remain a non-PASS acceptance state.

line_evidence.observation: Chain-B expected parameter pairs and t=.5*inner are derived from engine metadata and hard-coded sweep construction.
line_evidence.conclusion: The axis mapping is exercised, but this does not independently validate the physical solve beyond the constructed analytic expression.

line_evidence.observation: Final numeric_cases.json is written only after the preceding cases complete.
line_evidence.conclusion: An exception before this write can leave per-case assertion files but no consolidated numeric ledger; the outer runner must classify that as incomplete.

false_pass_risks.finding: Flatten-only scalar comparison omits FieldArray shape/axis identity for most cases.
RUNNING/QUEUED/rpc_wait_expired success data is not reconciled before the next mutation.
C10 records PARTIAL; an outer caller that does not inspect records can promote incomplete coverage.

cleanup_risks.finding: The helper writes JSON checkpoints but does not own model/worker cleanup; correctness depends on the caller's OwnedHost/finally path.
If an unresolved non-error running envelope is accepted, the caller may close or mutate while work remains active.

files.responsibility: Fresh stdio acceptance orchestration, owned server/worker teardown, Gate-A reopen, negative controls and numerical/export sub-suite delegation.

phases.name: isolated_server
phases.meaning: Starts one new mphserver in run-private prefs/tmp/recovery and terminates only the process it started.

phases.name: owned_host_teardown
phases.meaning: Observes pending jobs, retains runtime on unresolved work, closes transport and terminates freshly identified private processes.

phases.name: trusted_java
phases.meaning: Hashes/stores source artifacts and dispatches code.execute_java; checks worker success and attempts UNKNOWN observation/retry.

phases.name: gate_a_exercise
phases.meaning: Builds/saves/reopens Chain A/B/C, checks fresh server identity and stale references, then invokes verify_reopen.

phases.name: negative_controls
phases.meaning: Checks hash/dataset/solution/derived/value failures and modified/cleared copies, plus an intentional Java fault.

phases.name: numerical_suite
phases.meaning: Delegates live numeric/control/node/export cases and tears down through OwnedHost.

phases.name: exploratory_probes
phases.meaning: Native API observations explicitly described as exploratory, not a passing numerical gate.

oracle_sources: Public MCP response status and job logs for lifecycle/idempotency checks.
Freshly built source strings extracted from current tests/run_g3_3_live_acceptance.py (lines 161-168).
Chain-A point values have analytic checks in points() (lines 284-301); Chain-B/C reopen expectations are captured from pre-save reads (lines 375-382).
verify_reopen model identity, artifact hash, dataset/solution and derived-value checks (lines 414-419 and negatives 427-524).

line_evidence.observation: OwnedHost marks active/rpc_wait_expired/UNKNOWN jobs pending and polls job_status/job_reconcile until terminal or metadata.reconciled_quiescent.
line_evidence.conclusion: This is the intended no-kill boundary for active jobs, but only terminal/quiescent observations release the pending set.

line_evidence.observation: Cleanup iterates endpoint files and asserts all recorded results are EXITED; missing endpoints or absent process snapshots are skipped.
line_evidence.conclusion: all([]) can make cleanup look successful without proving that no owned child existed; a missing/invalid endpoint is not recorded as an explicit verification state.

line_evidence.observation: On Java failure the code observes job_status/result/reconcile, then for UNKNOWN replays the exact request and compares bounded job-log events.
line_evidence.conclusion: The replay is attempted before an explicit terminal/quiescent proof. Equal logs and same job id prove idempotency response shape, not that the original work was no longer active.

line_evidence.observation: A successful reply is required to contain worker.ok=True and worker.status=SUCCEEDED.
line_evidence.conclusion: A success=True envelope with data.status RUNNING/rpc_wait_expired is not classified here and can raise or bypass intended active-job handling.

line_evidence.observation: Receipts record point values from the builder; after reopen read values are flattened and passed into verify_reopen as the evaluator.
line_evidence.conclusion: For B/C this verifies persistence/shape against the reopened read, but the value oracle is not independent of that same read; a systematic post-reopen mapping error could self-consistently pass.

line_evidence.observation: export_only asserts no FAIL/BLOCKED and PASS>0; normal numerical_suite discards the run_numeric_cases return value.
line_evidence.conclusion: It does not assert an overall report status or enforce a budget witness, and C10 PARTIAL from the helper is not promoted by this caller.

line_evidence.observation: axis_probe docstring says native API observations are not a passing numerical gate.
line_evidence.conclusion: These probes must remain observations in acceptance accounting.

false_pass_risks.finding: UNKNOWN Java request is retried before quiescence is proven.
Gate-A B/C stored-value evaluator is coupled to the reopened read rather than an independent analytic oracle.
Delegated numerical/export statuses are incompletely aggregated; explicit PARTIAL or missing overall status can be lost.

cleanup_risks.finding: Empty cleanup result is vacuously accepted; endpoint absence/invalid PID is not an explicit cleanup failure.
Unknown replay can create a second mutation window while the original job remains active.
On quiescence observation failure runtime is retained, but the caller must preserve and later reconcile that retained process; this branch is not a PASS.

files.responsibility: Unified local COMSOL C00-C17 runner; combines static package checks, live worker cases, numerical oracles, export/chunk controls and teardown ledger.
oracle_sources: Analytic constants and tolerance records are source-defined in each numerical case (C04-C10).
Fresh engine reads for point/aggregate/table/probe checks where stated in the case code.
Gate-A artifact hash, dataset/solution/derived identity and saved-solution reads from reopened workers.
Static lock/catalog/schema/wheel inspection for C00/C01/C16; these are delivery checks, not COMSOL scientific validation.

cases.scope: clean recovery, source binding, wheel build and out-of-tree wheel import; delivery/static plus packaging.
hashes fixed historical evidence and correction ledger; static integrity only.
cleanup_failed classification and fail-closed export refusal; no live engine read.
live Chain A/B/C save/reopen, negative copies, independent re-solve; Gate-A and numerical.
constant field integral/average/std/RMS and denominator oracle.
2-D partition plus fresh 1-D wire and 3-D block dimensions, temperature and empty-selection refusal.
axisymmetric cylinder volume, mean radius and cross-section/revolved measures.
transient solution axis, point shape, slices, expression relation and range refusals.
CutPoint2D read and dataset-chain cycle detection, including a mock-only cycle control.
path traversal, export refusal, atomic rollback/publish; calls production export directly.
artifact.read chunk reconstruction, digest/refusal checks and client tracemalloc comparison.
live probe/table separation, dispatch reachability and readback.
same/different request hashes, live control responsiveness, solve completion and stale reference.
dependency lock/source identity, wheel resource presence and schema/catalog parse.
owned worker/server teardown, locks and derived run status.

line_evidence.observation: Java fixture helper requires ok=True and status=SUCCEEDED.
line_evidence.conclusion: Engine fixture failures are surfaced before reading an unchanged model.

line_evidence.observation: _flatten_scalars removes nesting and maps all leaves to floats.
line_evidence.conclusion: This convenience comparison is shape-insensitive unless the case separately checks shape.

line_evidence.observation: _reopen_evaluator explicitly indexes the reopened value list; comments document the former x==x defect.
line_evidence.conclusion: Current Gate-A evaluator is improved for actual reopened reads, but the value list remains a same-read oracle unless analytic expectations are separately supplied.

line_evidence.observation: C01 checks exact historical hashes and correction levels.
line_evidence.conclusion: PASS means static ledger integrity; it cannot establish fresh engine behavior.

line_evidence.observation: C02 classifies cleanup_failed and checks a failed export does not create a file.
line_evidence.conclusion: This is a production contract test; no live COMSOL result is exercised.

line_evidence.observation: Chain-B/C expectations are pre-save reads, while Chain-A has an analytic profile and negative copies.
line_evidence.conclusion: B/C demonstrate stored-value preservation and identity, not an independent physical solution oracle.

line_evidence.observation: Cleared copy is read through engine and then passed to verify_reopen; a returned value is treated as a defect.
line_evidence.conclusion: This is a meaningful stale/cleared negative control because it does not replay captured numbers.

line_evidence.observation: Mutated copy is re-solved, hashed after mutation and read through engine before mismatch assertion.
line_evidence.conclusion: This negative control binds both digest and changed numerical value.

line_evidence.observation: C04 verifies analytic constant-field values and reported denominator.
line_evidence.conclusion: Numerical oracle is concrete and engine-reported measure is checked.

line_evidence.observation: C05 builds/solves 1-D and 3-D fixtures, checks measures, temperatures and empty selections.
line_evidence.conclusion: Dimension coverage is materially stronger than a 2-D-only test; worker close is attempted in finally at 2005-2010.

line_evidence.observation: C06 checks x+2y analytic integrals and all derived statistics with tolerance records.
line_evidence.conclusion: Independent polynomial oracle is explicit.

line_evidence.observation: C07 checks cylinder formulas plus axisymmetric metadata/measure fields.
line_evidence.conclusion: Axisymmetric weighting is checked as a semantic result, subject to the stated 1e-6 tolerance.

line_evidence.observation: C08 checks engine time values [0..5], shape [expressions,solutions,points], slices and invalid ranges.
line_evidence.conclusion: This is a concrete axis/shape oracle with relation x*T, not only scalar flattening.

line_evidence.observation: C09 checks complex modes and explicitly rejects missing imaginary data.
line_evidence.conclusion: The negative control is no longer swallowed by a broad except in this source.

line_evidence.observation: C11 catches any exception while attempting CutPoint2D creation, then evaluates cpt1.
line_evidence.conclusion: A pre-existing or partially created cpt1 could make this control ambiguous; creation failure should be recorded explicitly.

line_evidence.observation: C12 checks traversal, failed export preservation, staged writer rollback, success ZIP/hash, absolute destination refusal and direct _export_to_artifact publish.
line_evidence.conclusion: The atomic controls are meaningful; the direct export call must match the current project-root/overwrite contract before live reuse.

line_evidence.observation: C13 reconstructs via host dispatch and validates chunk/whole hashes; tracemalloc compares stream and full-read client allocations.
line_evidence.conclusion: This proves bounded client transport behavior for these artifacts, not COMSOL engine internal memory or raw getData peak.

line_evidence.observation: C14 creates/removes a live probe, exercises dispatch, refuses unimplemented operations and writes/reads/removes a table.
line_evidence.conclusion: Probe/table separation is live; table removal has no post-remove readback assertion.

line_evidence.observation: C15 uses a fixed 2 s health budget during an actual >1 s Java solve, waits for completion, checks post-solve read and stale reference.
line_evidence.conclusion: This is a substantive active-control test; worker close is in finally, so a solve-thread failure needs separate retained-runtime handling.

line_evidence.observation: C16 checks current lock/source identity and wheel resources, building a wheel with pip wheel --no-deps if C00 did not.
line_evidence.conclusion: Resource presence and source binding are checked, but this branch does not fresh-install the fallback wheel or run pip check itself.

line_evidence.observation: C17 closes verifier worker, stops the isolated server, checks locks and derives status from every prior case.
line_evidence.conclusion: Teardown verdict is only meaningful when every earlier case recorded an explicit result and process ownership is verified.

line_evidence.observation: run_case_guarded converts escaping exceptions into FAIL records and continues through C17.
line_evidence.conclusion: Failure recording is safer than aborting, but a later case can still depend on missing C03 artifacts and must remain a visible cascade failure.

false_pass_risks.finding: Gate-A Chain-B/C value preservation uses captured pre-save values as the expected source; it is not a physical analytic oracle.
C11 swallows every CutPoint2D construction error before evaluating the tag.
C16 fallback wheel path builds but does not install and import that fallback wheel in a clean environment.
C13 memory assertions cover Python tracemalloc for artifact reads, not engine-side or JSON/Python field-array allocation during evaluation.

cleanup_risks.finding: Failed atomic-save candidates are intentionally retained as incident evidence; C12 therefore does not claim a clean artifact directory after failure.
Worker close is attempted in finally, but no explicit retained-runtime path is recorded if a background solve thread remains alive after an exception.
Probe removal is verified, while table removal is issued without a post-removal readback.

required_follow_up: Keep the automated 80-file inventory explicitly non-semantic.
Reconcile running/rpc_wait_expired envelopes before any subsequent mutation in numeric helpers.
Require an independent budget witness before raw getData/export and aggregate delegated status without dropping PARTIAL.
Do not replay UNKNOWN Java requests until a terminal/quiescent observation is proven.
Distinguish missing endpoint/process evidence from an empty successful cleanup result.
Rerun all live cases after source freeze; this report itself is not a replacement for that run.
